card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 13 Rear Camera Not Focusing After A Drop

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 13 Rear Camera Not Focusing After A Drop

symptoms: rear camera will not focus after drop

claims.statement: iPhone 13 rear camera that cannot focus after a drop, unchanged by a new camera, is usually cracked inter-layer joints breaking the I2C2 lines between the camera PMU, strobe IC and camera.
The fix is to separate and reball the sandwich (interposer) rather than reflow it.

procedure: Confirm with a known-good rear camera.
Inspect the board near the rear camera for flex/delamination.
Separate top and bottom boards on a preheater; reball interposer with 148/158 paste.
Rejoin, check for shorts, test focus in all modes.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
